name: aba-mart
description: ABA Mart - multi-category online retail store with WhatsApp checkout

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,green,blue "npm run dev -w @aba-mart/shared" "npm run dev -w @aba-mart/api" "npm run dev -w @aba-mart/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @aba-mart/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @aba-mart/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @aba-mart/api && npm run build -w @aba-mart/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
